theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_diag_dense_family_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (μ ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet O → C ≠ ∞ → (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, μ k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ν k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, g m z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, g m z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, f z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
